user.description: Select an existing session discovered from wwebjs-api, or choose Create a new session.

new.title: Create WWebJS sender
new.description: Create a new wwebjs-api session and pair it using a phone-number code.

data_description.session_id: Alphanumeric characters and hyphen are supported by wwebjs-api.

pair.description: In WhatsApp, open Linked devices → Link a device → Link with phone number, then enter **{pairing_code}**. After linking succeeds, press Submit.

reconfigure.description: Current WWebJS session state: **{state}**. Enter the WhatsApp phone number to request a new phone-number pairing code for this existing session.

reconfigure_pair.title: Link {session}
reconfigure_pair.description: In WhatsApp, open Linked devices → Link a device → Link with phone number, then enter **{pairing_code}**. After linking succeeds, press Submit.

error.session_not_pairable: This session is not currently in a state that supports phone-number pairing.
